SELECT DL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID AS totalTradeId, DL.TRADE_ID AS tradeId, (case DL.BUSI_TYPE when '17' then 'N' when '21' then 'M' else 'R' end) AS busiType, (case INFO.P_FINPROD_ID when NULL then NULL else INFO.FINPROD_MARKET_ID end) AS fprodId, (case INFO.P_FINPROD_ID when NULL then INFO.FINPROD_MARKET_ID else DL.FINPROD_ID end) AS prodId, NULL issuePartyId, (case INFO.P_FINPROD_ID when NULL then INFO.FINPROD_MARKET_ID else DL.FINPROD_ID end) AS indentifyMark,/*未接入销售系统数据，暂时由产品代码填空*/ '000000' buyPlace,/*未接入销售系统数据，暂时常量填空*/ '999999' customerType1,/*客户一级类型未接入销售系统数据，暂时常量填空*/ '999999' customerType2,/*客户二级类型未接入销售系统数据，暂时常量填空*/ (case DL.PS when 'C6' then (case DL.TRADE_AMT when NULL then DL.PS else 'C4' end) when 'C3' then (case DL.TRADE_AMT when NULL then DL.PS else 'C2' end) else DL.PS end) AS tradeType, DL.TRADE_DATE AS settdateDate, DL.SETTLE_DATE AS payDate, DL.SETTLE_DATE AS interestDate, DL.INT_AMT AS intAmt, DL.TRADE_AMT AS tradePrince, DL.UNIT_INT AS unitBonusAmount, DL.SHARE_AMT AS tradeQty, DL.CCY AS ccy, DL.CCY AS interestCcy, (case REVDL.UPDATE_TIME when NULL then 'E' else 'D' end) status, (case ifnull(pl.IS_SALE,'N') when 'Y' then '01' else '02' end) isagency, REVDL.UPDATE_TIME AS revDate, DL.REMARK AS remark, DL.CREATE_TIME AS createTime, ADD1.RED_COST AS redCost, ADD1.RED_PROFIT AS redprofit, ifnull(DL.UPDATE_TIME,DL.CREATE_TIME) AS updateTime FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL DL
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT INFO ON DL.FINPROD_ID = INFO.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL REVDL ON DL.TRADE_ID = REVDL.P_TRADE_ID
left join prd_layer_param pl on pl.FINPROD_ID=DL.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD ADD1 ON DL.TRADE_ID = ADD1.TRADE_ID
WHERE DL.PS IN ('C1','C2','C3','C4','C5','C6','C7','C9','C10','C14','C15','C17','C18','C20') AND DL.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN ('F16','F26','F24')---增加分层产品F24的接入 AND DL.BUSI_TYPE IN ('17','21','27') AND ((REVDL.UPDATE_TIME IS NOT NULL AND ifnull(REVDL.UPDATE_TIME,REVDL.CREATE_TIME) > #{batchTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) OR (REVDL.UPDATE_TIME IS NULL AND ifnull(DL.UPDATE_TIME,DL.CREATE_TIME) > #{batchTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) ) and ifnull(dl.p_trade_id,'NOREV') = 'NOREV' AND DL.IS_CANCEL IS NOT NULL
#{prodCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
order by DL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID,DL.TRADE_ID

SELECT DISTINCT FEEDETAIL.TRADE_ID AS tradeId, (case INFO.P_FINPROD_ID when NULL then NULL else INFO.FINPROD_MARKET_ID end) AS fprodId, (case INFO.FINPROD_MARKET_ID when NULL then (SELECT PROD.FINPROD_MARKET_ID FROM FIN_PRODUCT_ADD INFOADD LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT PROD ON INFOADD.FINPROD_ID = PROD.FINPROD_ID WHERE INFOADD.PORTFOLIO_ID = DL.FINPROD_ID AND 1=1 limit 1 ) else (case INFO.P_FINPROD_ID when NULL then INFO.FINPROD_MARKET_ID else DL.FINPROD_ID end) end) AS prodId, (case INFO.FINPROD_MARKET_ID when NULL then (SELECT PROD.FINPROD_NAME FROM FIN_PRODUCT_ADD INFOADD LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT PROD ON INFOADD.FINPROD_ID = PROD.FINPROD_ID WHERE INFOADD.PORTFOLIO_ID = DL.FINPROD_ID AND 1=1 limit 1 ) else INFO.FINPROD_NAME end) AS prodName, FEINFO.FEE_ID feeId, FEINFO.FEE_NAME feeName, FEINFO.ORG_TYPE feeType, (case DL.FINPROD_TYPE2 when 'C04' then '11' else FEINFO.ORG_TYPE2 end) feeSectype, DL.CCY ccy, FEEDETAIL.FEE_AMT amt, DL.SETTLE_DATE payDate, (case REVDL.UPDATE_TIME when NULL then 'E' else 'D' end) status, DL.REMARK remark, DL.CREATE_TIME AS createTime, ifnull(DL.UPDATE_TIME,DL.CREATE_TIME) AS updateTime, ifnull(acct2.ACCT_NAME, acct1.ACCT_NAME) tradeCounter, case when ifnull(acct2.ACCOUNT_NATURE,acct1.ACCOUNT_NATURE) = '01' then '04' when ifnull(acct2.ACCOUNT_NATURE,acct1.ACCOUNT_NATURE) = '02' then '06' end as rivalPartyType, DL.FINPROD_TYPE cashType2 FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL DL
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT INFO ON DL.FINPROD_ID = INFO.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL REVDL ON DL.TRADE_ID = REVDL.P_TRADE_ID
LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL FEEDETAIL ON DL.TRADE_ID = FEEDETAIL.TRADE_ID
LEFT JOIN MST_FEEINFO FEINFO ON FEINFO.FEE_ID = FEEDETAIL.FEE_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL TPD ON TPD.TOTLE_TRADE_ID=DL.TRADE_ID
LEFT JOIN STL_PAY_ORDERS ORDERS2 ON DL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = ORDERS2.TRADE_ID AND ORDERS2.PAY_TYPE = '02'
LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO ACCT2 ON ORDERS2.COUNTER_ACCT_NO = ACCT2.ACCT_NO
LEFT JOIN STL_PAY_ORDERS ORDERS1 ON DL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = ORDERS1.TRADE_ID AND ORDERS1.PAY_TYPE = '01'
LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO ACCT1 ON ORDERS1.COUNTER_ACCT_NO = ACCT1.ACCT_NO WHERE /*DL.PS = 'C11'*/
/*AND*/ ((REVDL.UPDATE_TIME IS NOT NULL AND ifnull(REVDL.UPDATE_TIME,REVDL.CREATE_TIME) > #{batchTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) OR (REVDL.UPDATE_TIME IS NULL AND ifnull(DL.UPDATE_TIME,DL.CREATE_TIME) > #{batchTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) ) and ifnull(dl.p_trade_id,'NOREV') = 'NOREV' AND DL.IS_CANCEL IS NOT NULL
